plan.notes: Source: official College of Southern Idaho 2024-2025 catalog, 'Spanish for Heritage Speakers, Associate of Arts' program page (Major Code: 1325R), hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from https://csi.smartcatalogiq.com/en/2024-2025/2024-2025-catalog/english-language-and-philosophy-department/spanish/spanish-for-heritage-speakers-associate-of-arts . Transcription method: fetched the official program page and transcribed the published requirement tables verbatim (course codes, titles, credits, printed semester totals).  TRUE award: Associate of Arts (page title). Catalog year 2024-2025: the newest CSI catalog with complete published program pages found (a 2025-2026 catalog exists but its program pages were not locatable; the 2024-2025 pages are complete and officially published). Total credits: 60, the catalog's published total ('Total Credit Hours: 60'); semester tables print 16/15/16/13 and sum exactly as modeled. Honest modeling notes: (1) Fall Sophomore lists 'MATH - Any Math Course' with NO printed credit value; 3 credits is implied by the printed 16-credit semester total (3+3+3+3+4=16 with MATH at 3). (2) Spring Sophomore: 'ELEC ANY 2 Credits OR ELEC ANY 3 Credits OR SPAN 200I Spanish Independent Study 1-3 Credits' - modeled at 2 (minimum-credit path); the catalog note says the student 'takes any college elective for 2-3 credits (including the option of a special topics/directed reading/independent study course, SPAN 200I) to get 60 program credits total'. (3) 'SCIG GE Any Gen Ed Science Course 3-4 Credits' in Spring Sophomore modeled at 4 - the value required, with the elective at 2, for the semester to sum to the printed 13 and the plan to reach the catalog's published 60 total. Choice slots: SUR LIT - any three of ENGL 257/258/267/268/277/278; FOR LANG / FOR LANG2 - 'Any Selected Foreign Language Course' / 'Any 2nd Selected Foreign Language Course', 4 cr each; COMM GE / SOCS GE / WELL GE / SOCS GE2 / SCIG GE / SCIG GE2 are official catalog placeholders (student choice). Prereqs: left empty. The catalog marks courses with '*' as 'Prerequisite or corequisite required' but does not name the prerequisite on the plan page; per-course prerequisites live on the official catalog course pages, not the plan page.
